purpose: Audit the V1.7/V1.8 portfolio chronology and test whether the fixed strategy's trade expectancy differs across a slow, predeclared market-state classification. This experiment is diagnostic only and must not tune strategy parameters or change production rules.

data.period: 2022-01-01 through 2026-08-28, with frozen lookback rows from 2021-09-03
data.knownLimitation: Current-universe survivorship bias remains; this experiment does not claim point-in-time universe correctness.

fixedStrategy.entrySignal: MA5 rising, close above MA5, previous close at/below previous MA5
fixedStrategy.entry: next trading day's daily open proxy
fixedStrategy.exit: MA5/MA10 death cross confirmed at close, exit next open
fixedStrategy.selectionPriority: higher MA5 slope, then higher signal-day trade value, then symbol

engineAudit.legacyControl: Preserve V1.7C simulator output as the control.
cleanChronology: Never use current-session close to size an opening trade.
Size opening trades from prior-session close equity only.
Process same-open scheduled exits before new entries so exit proceeds are available in the clean-recycle variant.
Also report a conservative no-same-open-recycle variant as a bound.
Use integer share quantities; no fractional shares. Daily open remains only an execution proxy because historical 09:10 odd-lot prices are not in this freeze.
engineAudit.comparisonPolicy: Report the numerical impact of chronology and share granularity. Do not choose whichever variant has the best return.

featuresKnownBySignalClose: cross-sectional percentage of eligible equity rows closing above MA60
20-session mean advance ratio as a diagnostic only

classification.RISK_ON: 0050 close > MA120 AND MA60 20-session slope > 0 AND breadthAboveMA60 >= 55%
classification.RISK_OFF: 0050 close < MA120 AND MA60 20-session slope < 0 AND breadthAboveMA60 <= 45%
classification.UNKNOWN: insufficient lookback or fewer than 700 valid equity observations

marketState.important: These thresholds are predeclared for diagnosis and will not be optimized on 2022-2026 results.

outputs: legacy versus clean portfolio results by calendar year 2022-2026
fixed-strategy candidate-trade count, win rate, expectancy, profit factor and payoff ratio by signal-day market state
same trade-state metrics by year to expose regime instability
monthly market-state distribution and latest frozen state

decisionPolicy.interpretation: If a market state shows weak expectancy, treat it as a hypothesis for a future strategy generation. Do not immediately add a filter using these already-inspected years.
decisionPolicy.nextStepIfStateDependenceAppears: Build a separate point-in-time universe and an earlier/rolling development set, then preregister a second-generation regime model before testing it.
